method.warmup: one API warmup inside every probe process; one separate CLI warmup per revision/workload
method.samples: 3 paired samples, alternating before/after execution order; all serial
method.timing: API Instant surrounds analysis only; fixture generation and request construction excluded. CLI process_elapsed_ns surrounds the whole CLI subprocess; excludes Python wrapper startup.
method.heap: requested live/peak byte deltas and allocator call counts sampled around API analysis; caller-owned source/ranges/request excluded. Does not represent malloc usable size or RSS.
method.rss: macOS resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss bytes in a fresh wrapper with one bounded child; includes child runtime and API warmup, not API-only or simultaneous aggregate tree peak. /usr/bin/time -l was unusable because sandbox denies kern.clockrate sysctl.
method.payload: output_string_bytes counts returned path/original/replacement/symbol bytes only; not full logical candidate payload charge. Sparse/control have no candidates and zero payload charge. Dedicated unit tests establish exact payload boundaries.
method.disk: CLI fixture input sizes recorded; API retains no disk output. JSON stdout is captured, including all plan machine output, so its hash may expose nondeterministic metadata; selection hash projects candidates/diagnostics/truncated.
method.limits: 30s per invocation; Git fixture command 20s; no concurrent build/benchmark, no timing assertion; scope fixed synthetic workloads.
